item.title: [Lanka Leader] SC concludes hearing on Anti-Corruption (Amendment) Bill; determination to be sent to speaker
item.description: The Supreme Court yesterday (4) announced that it will communicate its confidential determination on the constitutionality of the Anti-Corruption Amendment Bill presented by the Government to Parliament to both the President and the Speaker of Parliament, following the conclusion of hearings into petitions challenging the proposed legislation.

item.title: [Lanka Leader] With Namal remanded, Limini Rajapaksa expected to join SLPP Anuradhapura rally
item.description: Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna (SLPP) said that a mass rally in Anuradhapura will proceed as scheduled on 12 September, despite the arrest and remand of SLPP national organiser and MP Namal Rajapaksa.

item.title: [Lanka Leader] Solar boom outpaces technician training, regulator warns
